mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over the past quarter indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDP growth is positive, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points in the past month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the past month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 5% in the past two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4% and payroll employment increases by more than 200,000 in the past month, it signals a strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.3% in the past month, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and retail and food services sales increase by more than 1% in the past month, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 positive and RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of GDPC1 and RSAFS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
